raw_response:
The issuer exhibits severe financial distress with a dangerously low current ratio of 0.63, indicating acute liquidity issues and an inability to cover short-term obligations. High leverage is evident from a debt-to-equity ratio of approximately 14.5, coupled with negative retained earnings (-5,086M), eroding solvency. Although the EBIT margin is healthy at around 42%, the low revenue base and high liabilities (52,835M) relative to EBIT (1,161M) suggest inadequate debt service capacity, placing the issuer in the highly vulnerable spectrum.

DECISION: CCC
